name: card-grid
description: A labeled list of cards with optional Expand all and Collapse all controls. The controls show icons by default.

parts.name: card-status
parts.description: State text in a nested card.

parts.name: card-toggle
parts.description: Button that expands or collapses a nested card.

parts.name: card-tooltip
parts.description: Name of the collapse control of a nested card on hover or focus.

parts.name: collapse-all
parts.description: Button that collapses all collapsible cards that can close.

parts.name: details
parts.description: Control and technical details of a refusal.

parts.name: empty
parts.description: Message that shows when there are no items.

parts.name: expand-all
parts.description: Button that expands all collapsible cards.

parts.name: icon
parts.description: Double chevron of a grid collapse control.

parts.name: reason
parts.description: Reason for a refusal or an edit error.

parts.name: tooltip
parts.description: Name of the grid icon control on hover or focus. Escape closes it.
